opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (next of bi-monthly deadlines on 1st Feb, Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct, Dec)

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200 for GS/SIG meetings; Scheme B up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards) for non-GS meetings; Scheme C up to £300 for virtual conferences

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members. Scheme A: undergraduate, Master's and PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk; supervisors must be members. UK-base conditions apply for B & C.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics, covering travel, accommodation and/or registration for GS/SIG meetings, non-GS meetings, and virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: 15th November 2026 (next of quarterly deadlines on 15th Feb, May, Aug, Nov)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be members for at least one year. Supervisors must be members.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques, covering travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration/tuition fees.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st November 2026 (next of quarterly deadlines on 1st Feb, May, Aug, Nov)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be members for at least one year. Supervisors must be members.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project whose results would typically be suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (next of two annual deadlines on 1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering eligible travel and materials costs for activities delivered in person or virtually.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member with caring responsibilities, regardless of age of the person cared for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Awards to enable members with caring responsibilities to attend Genetics Society meetings and events, to be used as they think best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several levels: a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds; a session up to about £1,000; major sponsorship of several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorship £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members organising one-off genetic themed meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of one-off genetic themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards organisation of the meeting (not attendance), including a Carer's Award.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members and genetics research communities wishing to run a regular series of themed meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings.
